PRC-2026.1 was applied provisionally as the latest and stricter policy, and pricing_desk is asked to confirm the governing policy.

The merchant says the Q4GROWTH code came from a newsletter; this is unverified. Q4GROWTH is not a valid code under the policy, so it gives no margin relief and the micro minimum margin stays at 32%.

Using the merchant-specific cost of 1.80% + $0.10, the requested 1.72% + $0.30 would yield monthly revenue of $837.20 against cost of $598.00. That is a margin of 28.57%, below the 32% minimum, so the request cannot be accepted as asked.

We counter at 1.89% + $0.30:
- Monthly revenue: $881.40
- Monthly cost: $598.00
- Gross profit: $283.40
- Gross margin: 32.15%, which meets the minimum.

This is a 22.95% discount against list revenue of $1,144.00 (2.90% + $0.30). That exceeds 12%, so regional_pricing_manager approval is required.
